block-handbooktext-estove:
The electric stove can completely replace a regular campfire.
Supports automatic input and output via chutes.

Maximum heating temperature: 1350 °C.
block-handbooktext-eoven:
The electric oven can completely replace a clay oven. It turns off automatically when the baking process is finished. No more burning!
Supports automatic input and output via chutes.
block-handbooktext-ehorn:
The electric forge can completely replace a regular blacksmith's forge.

Maximum heating temperature: 1100 °C.
Supports automatic input and output via chutes.
block-handbooktext-heater:
A small heat source that can provide an additional temperature bonus to garden beds, fruit trees, regular trees (seeds and saplings), berry bushes, and beehives in a greenhouse. One such heater at full power gives +5 degrees per 100 blocks of internal greenhouse volume. This volume includes the beds themselves. The effect of heaters can stack: the total bonus can be viewed on any of them. The bonus information updates as soon as any plant recalculates.
Growing fruit trees will not become easier: you will still have to follow all their growth cycles, so you will need to adjust the resulting temperature with heaters according to the current stage of the tree. Cuttings must overwinter for several days at low temperatures, and then by gradually raising the temperature, wait for them to take root (or not). After that, you can further increase the internal temperature to comfortable values for that tree, and it will begin to bloom, bear fruit, etc. Each tree has its own temperature ranges, so be careful not to harm it. As soon as it finishes fruiting, you can again forcibly force the tree into dormancy. The cycle repeats as needed.

block-handbooktext-elamp_small: A light source that consumes electrical energy.

freezer-over-help: Open the door and put food inside to preserve it.
block-handbooktext-efridge:
The electric refrigerator allows you to store food longer.

Storage slots: 6.
Food spoilage rate: 0.1x.
Can keep cold inside for up to 6 in-game hours after power loss.
block-handbooktext-efreezer:
The electric freezer allows you to store food for a long time. It can also store one animal carcass from the Butchering mod.

Storage slots: 6.
Food spoilage rate: 0.025x.
Can keep cold inside for up to 6 in-game hours after power loss.
block-handbooktext-efence: Good protection against unwanted guests. Deals electric damage on contact. Does not consume energy, but must be connected to an electrical circuit to work.
